body:
incident-bot: pager: GPU capacity alarm triggered for prod-cluster (queue > 500 for 3m) :rotating_light: paging sre-oncall

maria: I'm on it, grabbing context. seeing sustained queue growth on inference-prod, tokens/sec down ~60%.

jamal: logs show cluster-autoscaler attempted scale up but nodes stuck in Pending for ~4m. ASG shows new instances, but taints not applied.

kevin: can you paste the CA events?

jamal: kube-events snippet:
```
Normal  Scheduled   pod/my-inference-pod  2m  Successfully assigned ...
Warning FailedScheduling pod/my-inference-pod  2m  0/10 nodes are available: 10 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
Normal  ScaleUp  cluster-autoscaler  90s  3 nodes added to gpu-nodegroup-prod (api call)
Warning  NodeNotReady  ip-10-0-45-12  70s  Node registration timed out, kubelet image pull fail
```

maria: aws ASG shows instances launched but attach-role log shows `AttachRolePolicy` race: instance profile not found at time of attach.

ops-bot: aws event: Instance i-0b7f... lifecycle action failed: AttachInstanceProfile -> NoSuchEntity

phil: launch template drift? I see autoscaler requested lt version v3, fleet used v1 in cloud provider logs.

kevin: that would explain IAM errors. lt v1 had wrong instance profile name. when CA uses latest launch template but ASG still using older version, instance profile attach fails.

maria: customer impact: multiple queued requests being throttled, p99 latency for realtime endpoints jumped to 18s, errors ~1.9% over last 5m. need mitigation to reduce customer-facing errors.

tara: immediate mitigations: 1) scale a CPU-only fallback pool and temporarily route low-priority workloads there, 2) manually attach correct instance profile to ASG or roll ASG to LT v3, 3) cordon/evict any stuck GPU nodes to free queue backpressure.

jamal: running manual scale now: `kubectl scale --replicas=20 deployment/inference-fallback-cpu -n prod`

kevin: I'm preparing ASG update: planning to update ASG launch template to v3 and do a rolling replace of instances. small risk but required. will do one AZ at a time.

maria: meanwhile add temporary routing rule to move non-SLA traffic to fallback: updating routing config.

phil: FYI i-0b7f... shows instance bootstrap errors: cloud-init failed to fetch profile because IMDS slow. could be AWS rate limit during surge.

ops-bot: cloudwatch metric: AttachInstanceProfileErrors spiked at 3:12 UTC.

jamal: I've cordoned the two Pending nodes so CA won't keep cycling them: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-45-12` and `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` as needed.

maria: check health of existing GPU pods: some are Pending due to insufficient GPUs, others are running but high CPU. eviction might free some slots.

kevin: ASG update started: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-nodegroup-prod --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc,Version=3`

phil: rolling replace initiated, terminating instances in az-a only (2 instances). monitoring for AttachInstanceProfileErrors.

maria: routing rule in place. non-SLA traffic at 70% moved to CPU fallback, allowed queue to drop ~30% in last 2 mins. p99 latency down to 11s.

ops-bot: incident-bot: manual mitigation steps logged to incident ticket #INC-3421.

jamal: manual scale of fallback completed, pods started ok. queue processed faster, token backlog trending down.

kevin: ASG apply shows success, new instances now launching with correct profile. verifying node registration...

phil: new nodes registered and taints applied automatically, kubelet joined. CA marked scale up as successful.

maria: good — nodes became Ready, GPU allocatable reported. started scheduling Pending pods onto new nodes.

jamal: observed one pod crashloop due to old nvidia-driver mismatch; rolled to new AMI tag that includes driver v525.

kevin: AMI roll completed for az-a, will proceed az-b after stabilization.

maria: current customer impact: errors down to 0.2%, p99 latency 4.1s, queue length reduced to ~40. continuing to monitor for 30m.

tara: postmortem notes to capture: launch template version skew, IMDS / IAM attach race under surge, autoscaler retried quickly causing duplicate attempts, no safe fallback routing by default. action items: 1) add LT version pinning + CA fallback policy, 2) retry/backoff for instance profile attach with better logging, 3) playbook for oncall to trigger CPU fallback, 4) test ASG rolling updates during surge in staging.

maria: assigning ACTIONS: @kevin update ASG automation to ensure LT version sync, @phil bake AMI with robust drivers and IMDS retry, @jamal add CA instrumentation for attach errors, @tara own postmortem.

kevin: ack, starting automation patch now.

phil: I'll coordinate AMI tests with infra tomorrow at 09:00.

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (customer impact reduced). Recording timeline to #incidents-archive.

maria: closing pager for now but keeping channel open for follow-ups. please add any additional notes. :white_check_mark:
